description: Source code for ZAiHandler class implementing a chat completion provider with thinking mode support, extending a base provider, handling model configurations, and creating chat streams with explicit reasoning control.

classes.name: ZAiHandler
classes.description: A class extending BaseOpenAiCompatibleProvider to handle chat completions with thinking mode support, model configuration, and stream creation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ZAiHandler with options, setting model configs based on region.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Overrides base method to handle GLM-4.7's thinking mode, enabling or disabling reasoning explicitly.

methods.name: createStreamWithThinking
methods.description: Creates a chat completion stream with explicit reasoning control, converting messages to ZAi format and setting thinking parameters.
